meta.title: DistLLM — Distributed LLM Inference Across All Your Devices
meta.description: Pool GPUs from every device you own to run models no single machine can handle. OpenAI-compatible. Open source. 10x cheaper than cloud APIs.

hero.title: Run 70B Models on Consumer GPUs
hero.subtitle: Pool GPUs from every device you own to run models no single machine can handle. OpenAI-compatible API. 10x cheaper than cloud APIs.

features.title: Why DistLLM?
features.subtitle: The only open-source solution for distributed LLM inference across consumer GPUs.

pipeline.title: Pipeline Parallelism
pipeline.description: Split model layers across GPUs in a pipeline. Near-linear scaling with each GPU added.

openai.title: OpenAI Compatible
openai.description: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI API. Works with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and any OpenAI SDK.

multiBackend.title: Multi-Backend
multiBackend.description: Supports vLLM, llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2. Use the best backend for each GPU type.

wan.title: WAN Support
wan.description: Connect GPUs across the internet with QUIC transport and NAT traversal.

security.title: Enterprise Security
security.description: mTLS, RBAC, audit logging. Air-gapped deployment for compliance requirements.

cost.title: 10x Cheaper
cost.description: ~$0.01/1K tokens for 70B models. 10x cheaper than OpenAI, 5x cheaper than cloud GPUs.

calculator.title: Cost Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Estimate your savings vs. cloud APIs

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Open source. Pay only for managed hosting.

gpus.question: What GPUs are supported?
gpus.answer: Any NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12+ (RTX 30xx, 40xx, A100, H100), AMD via ROCm, Apple Silicon via Metal, CPU-only via llama.cpp.

vllm.question: How does it compare to vLLM?
vllm.answer: vLLM is excellent for single-node inference. DistLLM's differentiator is multi-node pipeline parallelism.

security.question: Is my data safe?
security.answer: Yes. All data stays on your devices. DistLLM supports mTLS, E2E encryption, and standard authentication.

internet.question: Can I run it over the internet?
internet.answer: Yes. WAN support with QUIC transport, NAT traversal (STUN/TURN), and token accumulation.

models.question: What models are supported?
models.answer: Any HuggingFace model: Llama 2/3, Mistral, Mixtral, Qwen, Phi, DeepSeek, StableLM, GPT-2, and more.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: pip install distributed-llm, then distllm cluster start, then distllm cluster join on other machines.
